function.description: Use when you need to preview a text-like document, confirm relevant text, or search for the first case-insensitive keyword match. Use `has_more` and the next `start_line` to continue reading.
function.name: read_doc

keyword.description: Optional keyword; when set, returns a context window around the first match.

line_count.description: Number of lines to return in this page.

path.description: Relative path to a text document (md/txt/...). Examples: 'knowledge.md', 'docs/readme.txt'. Paths are relative to the task context directory; DO NOT prepend 'context/'. For example use 'knowledge.md' or 'csv/foo.csv', not 'context/knowledge.md'.

start_line.description: 1-based line number to start reading from.
